s0101.literal: That month, Dong'an Prefecture suffered locusts.
s0101.idiomatic: That month, Dong'an Prefecture suffered locusts.

s0102.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on renzi day an edict ordered Censor-in-Chief Yuerlu to restore censorate discipline and forbid inner and outer offices from reducing officials' salaries for banquet expenses.
s0102.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, on renzi day an edict ordered censor-in-chief Yuerlu to restore censorate discipline and forbid inner and outer offices from reducing officials' salaries for banquet expenses.

s0103.literal: The Longfu Palace guard-waiting office was established.
s0103.idiomatic: The Longfu Palace guard-waiting office was established.

s0104.literal: On guichou day an edict ordered military and civilian populations each to belong to their respective jurisdictions, without mutual encroachment.
s0104.idiomatic: On guichou day an edict ordered military and civilian populations each to belong to their respective jurisdictions, without mutual encroachment.

s0105.literal: On yimao day, because more than four hundred households under Prince Chubo's command lacked food, their families were relocated to inner circuits for provisions, and they were still granted three thousand ingots of notes as annual ordu army allotments.
s0105.idiomatic: On yimao day, because more than 400 households under Prince Chubo's command lacked food, their families were relocated to inner circuits for provisions, and they were still granted 3,000 ingots of notes as annual ordu army allotments.

s0106.literal: Notes of two thousand six hundred ingots were granted as cattle prices to people from Guazhou and Shazhou who had moved to garrison-farm at Ganzhou.
s0106.idiomatic: Notes of 2,600 ingots were granted as cattle prices to people from Guazhou and Shazhou who had moved to garrison-farm at Ganzhou.

s0107.literal: Yedimishi was appointed darughachi of Dongchang Route; central secretariat officials said he had once served in that circuit and committed more than five hundred offenses, and was unsuitable for reappointment; the Emperor said: "Try him for now."
s0107.idiomatic: Yedimishi was appointed darughachi of Dongchang Route; central secretariat officials said he had once served in that circuit and committed more than 500 offenses and was unsuitable for reappointment; the Emperor said, "Try him for now."

s0108.literal: On jiwei day Pu County of Pingyang Route, Boye County of Baoding Route, Xintai County of Tai'an Prefecture, and other counties were re-established.
s0108.idiomatic: On jiwei day Pu County of Pingyang Route, Boye County of Baoding Route, Xintai County of Tai'an Prefecture, and other counties were re-established.

s0109.literal: Prince Chubo's ordu army and Yesudai'er's Red Jacket army were granted sixty thousand bolts of silks each.
s0109.idiomatic: Prince Chubo's ordu army and Yesudai'er's Red Jacket army were granted 60,000 bolts of silks each.

s0110.literal: On gengshen day the Palace Guard Command was changed to the Longfu Palace Left and Right Directorates of Palace Guard Command;
s0110.idiomatic: On gengshen day the Palace Guard Command was changed to the Longfu Palace Left and Right Directorates of Palace Guard Command;

s0111.literal: Confiscated bribe-fine monies of the Shaanxi circuit surveillance commission that had formerly been given to the King of Anxi were ordered deposited separately by the branch secretariat.
s0111.idiomatic: Confiscated bribe-fine monies of the Shaanxi circuit surveillance commission that had formerly been given to the King of Anxi were ordered deposited separately by the branch secretariat.

s0112.literal: On renxu day an edict ordered Confucius to be honored throughout inner and outer domains.
s0112.idiomatic: On renxu day an edict ordered Confucius to be honored throughout inner and outer domains.

s0113.literal: On guihai day the Zhaozhou pacification commission was abolished and merged into Liaodong Circuit.
s0113.idiomatic: On guihai day the Zhaozhou pacification commission was abolished and merged into Liaodong Circuit.

s0114.literal: On wuchen day two hundred sixteen officials established in Bafan and other places were reduced.
s0114.idiomatic: On wuchen day 216 officials established in Bafan and other places were reduced.

s0115.literal: Bafan claimed nine hundred thousand newly submitted households and had four hundred twenty-four officials established; when officials were sent to verify, there were only one hundred sixty-five thousand-odd households; hence the reduction.
s0115.idiomatic: Bafan claimed 900,000 newly submitted households and had 424 officials established; when officials were sent to verify, there were only 165,000-odd households; hence the reduction.

s0116.literal: Yuedimishi and Cheng Pengfei of the mobile privy council were each promoted to grand councillor; central secretariat officials said: "Privy council officials should not be heavily given concurrent chief minister ranks."
s0116.idiomatic: Yuedimishi and Cheng Pengfei of the mobile privy council were each promoted to grand councillor; central secretariat officials said, "Privy council officials should not be heavily given concurrent chief minister ranks."

s0117.literal: The Emperor ordered that those of exalted military rank receive it.
s0117.idiomatic: The Emperor ordered that those of exalted military rank receive it.

s0118.literal: On xinwei day central secretariat officials said: "Previously the censorate impeached Vice Chancellor Arigh for having shared evil with Ahmad, an offense warranting death; fortunately he was pardoned — he should not hold executive power.
s0118.idiomatic: On xinwei day central secretariat officials said, "Previously the censorate impeached Vice Chancellor Arigh for having shared evil with Ahmad, an offense warranting death; fortunately he was pardoned — he should not hold executive power.

s0119.literal: We consider that after Arigh's offense he was able to warn and reform himself; we request he continue in office as before.
s0119.idiomatic: We consider that after Arigh's offense he was able to warn and reform himself; we request he continue in office as before.

s0121.literal: Annual income from abandoned military-household farmland and notes from redeeming crimes by military-administration officers were again submitted to the Privy Council.
s0121.idiomatic: Annual income from abandoned military-household farmland and notes from redeeming crimes by military-administration officers were again submitted to the Privy Council.

s0122.literal: On guiyou day Shaanxi branch secretariat grand councillor Buqumu was made central secretariat grand councillor.
s0122.idiomatic: On guiyou day Shaanxi branch secretariat grand councillor Buqumu was made central secretariat grand councillor.

s0123.literal: On jiaxu day a general directorate for route-level artisan households, hunters, falconry households, cotton tribute households, and the like was established, at rank three positive.
s0123.idiomatic: On jiaxu day a general directorate for route-level artisan households, hunters, falconry households, cotton tribute households, and the like was established, at rank 3 positive.

s0124.literal: An edict summoned and instructed the king of Siam, Kamardin, to come to court; if he had cause not to come, then his sons and younger brothers and accompanying ministers should enter as hostages.
s0124.idiomatic: An edict summoned and instructed the king of Siam, Kamardin, to come to court; if he had cause not to come, then his sons and younger brothers and accompanying ministers should enter as hostages.

s0125.literal: A darughachi said: "When persons under princes commit crimes, without reporting to court they execute and dispatch judgment on their own authority."
s0125.idiomatic: A darughachi said, "When persons under princes commit crimes, without reporting to court they execute and dispatch judgment on their own authority."

s0126.literal: An edict forbade and regulated this.
s0126.idiomatic: An edict forbade and regulated this.

s0127.literal: An edict ordered Yuerlu to guard the northern frontier; his army was granted ten thousand bolts of silks each, and western campaign soldiers were granted thirty thousand bolts of silks and thirty-six thousand six hundred ingots of notes.
s0127.idiomatic: An edict ordered Yuerlu to guard the northern frontier; his army was granted 10,000 bolts of silks each, and western campaign soldiers were granted 30,000 bolts of silks and 36,600 ingots of notes.

s0128.literal: Princess Buluqzhen and Prince Ajigi's younger sister Botu were granted silver and notes in graded amounts.
s0128.idiomatic: Princess Buluqzhen and Prince Ajigi's younger sister Botu were granted silver and notes in graded amounts.

s0129.literal: That month, Yangxin County of Di Prefecture suffered hail; great winds uprooted trees and tore off roofs; Nan Palace and Xinhe counties of Zhending Route and Lai Shui County of Yi Prefecture suffered hail.
s0129.idiomatic: That month, Yangxin County of Di Prefecture suffered hail; great winds uprooted trees and tore off roofs; Nan Palace and Xinhe counties of Zhending Route and Lai Shui County of Yi Prefecture suffered hail.

s0130.literal: Eighth month, on gengchen day Venus was visible by day.
s0130.idiomatic: Eighth month, on gengchen day Venus was visible by day.

s0131.literal: On guiwei day flood in Qian'an and other counties of Pingluan Route; their field rents were remitted.
s0131.idiomatic: On guiwei day flood in Qian'an and other counties of Pingluan Route; their field rents were remitted.

s0132.literal: On wuzi day the altars of Soil and Grain were first sacrificed to, using hall music; this was made annual.
s0132.idiomatic: On wuzi day the altars of Soil and Grain were first sacrificed to, using hall music; this was made annual.

s0133.literal: On jichou day Dadu intendant Duan Zhen and grand councillor Fan Wenhu were ordered to supervise dredging the Tonghui Canal, and were granted rank-two silver seals.
s0133.idiomatic: On jichou day Dadu intendant Duan Zhen and grand councillor Fan Wenhu were ordered to supervise dredging the Tonghui Canal, and were granted rank-2 silver seals.

s0134.literal: Soldiers were again ordered to dredge Lake Tai in western Zhejiang, the Dianshan Lake channels, and a new river grain-transport thousand-household office was established.
s0134.idiomatic: Soldiers were again ordered to dredge Lake Tai in western Zhejiang, the Dianshan Lake channels, and a new river grain-transport thousand-household office was established.

s0135.literal: An edict ordered the stored silver of circuit stabilization and note-treasury offices throughout the routes — nine hundred thirty-six thousand nine hundred fifty taels — aside from retaining one hundred ninety-two thousand four hundred fifty taels as note reserve, the rest was all transported to the capital.
s0135.idiomatic: An edict ordered the stored silver of circuit stabilization and note-treasury offices throughout the routes — 936,950 taels — aside from retaining 192,450 taels as note reserve, the rest was all transported to the capital.

s0136.literal: Ruicheng, Lingchuan, and other counties of Pingyang were re-established.
s0136.idiomatic: Ruicheng, Lingchuan, and other counties of Pingyang were re-established.

s0137.literal: On xinmao day, because Mangghusar's wife and children had been captured by the enemy, eight thousand ingots of notes were granted.
s0137.idiomatic: On xinmao day, because Mangghusar's wife and children had been captured by the enemy, 8,000 ingots of notes were granted.

s0138.literal: On wuxu day the moon encroached upon Bi, and Venus encroached upon Xuanyuan.
s0138.idiomatic: On wuxu day the moon encroached upon Bi, and Venus encroached upon Xuanyuan.

s0139.literal: That month, An'de County of De Prefecture suffered great wind, rain, and hail.
s0139.idiomatic: That month, An'de County of De Prefecture suffered great wind, rain, and hail.

s0140.literal: Ninth month, on renzi day, on the Birthday Festival the Emperor halted at the Three Tribal Camps and received congratulations from princes and officials.
s0140.idiomatic: Ninth month, on renzi day, on the Birthday Festival the Emperor halted at the Three Tribal Camps and received congratulations from princes and officials.

s0141.literal: On guichou day an edict ordered officials to preserve and succor the families of soldiers who died on the Java campaign.
s0141.idiomatic: On guichou day an edict ordered officials to preserve and succor the families of soldiers who died on the Java campaign.

s0142.literal: On jiayin day the Emperor orally appointed Prince Tutor Aq Buqa as chancellor.
s0142.idiomatic: On jiayin day the Emperor orally appointed Prince Tutor Aq Buqa as chancellor.

s0143.literal: On dingsi day Venus crossed the sky.
s0143.idiomatic: On dingsi day Venus crossed the sky.

s0144.literal: On gengshen day more than seven hundred men of Qolula and Nayan's faction were placed under Associate Privy Council Director Bulingqadai to train in naval warfare.
s0144.idiomatic: On gengshen day more than 700 men of Qolula and Nayan's faction were placed under Associate Privy Council Director Bulingqadai to train in naval warfare.

s0145.literal: On bingyin day the moon masked Saturn.
s0145.idiomatic: On bingyin day the moon masked Saturn.

s0146.literal: On xinwei day the moon encroached upon Xuanyuan.
s0146.idiomatic: On xinwei day the moon encroached upon Xuanyuan.

s0147.literal: On yihai day Venus encroached upon Right Executioner, and the moon encroached upon Pingdao.
s0147.idiomatic: On yihai day Venus encroached upon Right Executioner, and the moon encroached upon Pingdao.

s0148.literal: Toghtemür and others were dispatched as envoys to Gelang.
s0148.idiomatic: Toghtemür and others were dispatched as envoys to Gelang.

s0149.literal: That month, Ningjin and other counties of Zhao Prefecture suffered flood.
s0149.idiomatic: That month, Ningjin and other counties of Zhao Prefecture suffered flood.

s0150.literal: Winter, tenth month, on wuyin day the imperial carriage returned to Dadu.
s0150.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, on wuyin day the imperial carriage returned to Dadu.

s0151.literal: On xinsi day Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat officials said: "At the beginning of Your Majesty's accession, an edict remitted one-third of this year's field rents.
s0151.idiomatic: On xinsi day Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat officials said, "At the beginning of Your Majesty's accession, an edict remitted one-third of this year's field rents.

s0152.literal: Yet Jiangnan differs from Jiangbei — the poor tenant rich men's fields and pay rent yearly; what is remitted reaches only the landowner, while tenants still pay rent as before — so the grace reaches wealthy households but not impoverished commoners.
s0152.idiomatic: Yet Jiangnan differs from Jiangbei — the poor tenant rich men's fields and pay rent yearly; what is remitted reaches only the landowner, while tenants still pay rent as before — so the grace reaches wealthy households but not impoverished commoners.

s0153.literal: It is fitting that tenants paying landowners should likewise receive the remitted portion.
s0153.idiomatic: It is fitting that tenants paying landowners should likewise receive the remitted portion.

s0155.literal: Nine places under Liaoyang branch secretariat suffered great flood; the people were famished, and some rose as bandits; an order was given to relieve and succor them.
s0155.idiomatic: Nine places under Liaoyang branch secretariat suffered great flood; the people were famished, and some rose as bandits; an order was given to relieve and succor them.

s0156.literal: Jiangxi branch secretariat officials said: "Silver mines annually produce eleven thousand taels by quota, yet the quota is never reached and the people cannot bear it."
s0156.idiomatic: Jiangxi branch secretariat officials said, "Silver mines annually produce 11,000 taels by quota, yet the quota is never reached and the people cannot bear it."

s0157.literal: An order directed that from now on actual yields be collected, without fixed quota.
s0157.idiomatic: An order directed that from now on actual yields be collected, without fixed quota.

s0158.literal: On renwu day Venus encroached upon Left Executioner.
s0158.idiomatic: On renwu day Venus encroached upon Left Executioner.

s0159.literal: There were rites at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0159.idiomatic: There were rites at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0160.literal: On guisi day the moon masked Saturn.
s0160.idiomatic: On guisi day the moon masked Saturn.

s0161.literal: On yiwei day the moon encroached upon Well.
s0161.idiomatic: On yiwei day the moon encroached upon Well.

s0162.literal: The newly submitted Meng'ai chieftain of Jinzhi sent his son to court; a military-civilian general commission was established in that territory.
s0162.idiomatic: The newly submitted Meng'ai chieftain of Jinzhi sent his son to court; a military-civilian general commission was established in that territory.

s0163.literal: Zhu Qing and Zhang Xuan annually transported one million shi of grain by sea route; because metropolitan stores were ample, an edict stopped transport at three hundred thousand shi.
s0163.idiomatic: Zhu Qing and Zhang Xuan annually transported 1,000,000 shi of grain by sea route; because metropolitan stores were ample, an edict stopped transport at 300,000 shi.

s0164.literal: On xinchou day the Emperor instructed Vice Chancellor Arigh and Associate Administrator Liang Degui: "Central secretariat duties — you all harbor indolent hearts.
s0164.idiomatic: On xinchou day the Emperor instructed Vice Chancellor Arigh and Associate Administrator Liang Degui, "Central secretariat duties — you all harbor indolent hearts.

s0165.literal: When I was at Shangdu I ordered Yedimisha's confiscated property returned and Minglibuqar appointed — none of this has been carried out to this day.
s0165.idiomatic: When I was at Shangdu I ordered Yedimisha's confiscated property returned and Minglibuqar appointed — none of this has been carried out to this day.

s0166.literal: You also do not restrain the clerical bureaus, causing candidates for office to linger.
s0166.idiomatic: You also do not restrain the clerical bureaus, causing candidates for office to linger.

s0167.literal: Though Sangge was wicked, his subordinates feared his authority and administrative matters were all promptly decided.
s0167.idiomatic: Though Sangge was wicked, his subordinates feared his authority and administrative matters were all promptly decided.

s0168.literal: You must restrain your bureau subordinates; those who do not attend to business — beat them.
s0168.idiomatic: You must restrain your bureau subordinates; those who do not attend to business — beat them.

s0169.literal: Also convey my meaning to Right Chancellor Wanze.
s0169.idiomatic: Also convey my meaning to Right Chancellor Wanze.

s0170.literal: On renyin day Burma sent envoys presenting ten tame elephants as tribute.
s0170.idiomatic: On renyin day Burma sent envoys presenting 10 tame elephants as tribute.

s0171.literal: On yisi day envoys of Nanwuli, Sumadara, Jimilamou, and Tanyang were each sent back to their countries, granted two-pearl tiger tallies and gold and silver tallies, and gold, silks, and clothing in graded amounts.
s0171.idiomatic: On yisi day envoys of Nanwuli, Sumadara, Jimilamou, and Tanyang were each sent back to their countries, granted two-pearl tiger tallies and gold and silver tallies, and gold, silks, and clothing in graded amounts.

s0172.literal: Initially, when Yeqimishi campaigned against Java, he had summoned the coastal countries; accordingly Nanwuli and others sent men to submit; because merchants going to sea were prohibited and remained at the capital, now the merchant prohibition was relaxed, and so all were dispatched back.
s0172.idiomatic: Initially, when Yeqimishi campaigned against Java, he had summoned the coastal countries; accordingly Nanwuli and others sent men to submit; because merchants going to sea were prohibited and remained at the capital, now the merchant prohibition was relaxed, and so all were dispatched back.

s0173.literal: Eleventh month, on dingwei new moon day the Emperor paid court to the Empress Dowager at Longfu Palace, presenting jade registers and a jade seal.
s0173.idiomatic: Eleventh month, on dingwei new moon day the Emperor paid court to the Empress Dowager at Longfu Palace, presenting jade registers and a jade seal.

s0174.literal: On gengxu day Privy Council official Liu Guojie was ordered to suppress Chen Prefecture bandits; state commoners with crossbows were selected to assist his army; this was not made a precedent for other cases.
s0174.idiomatic: On gengxu day Privy Council official Liu Guojie was ordered to suppress Chen Prefecture bandits; state commoners with crossbows were selected to assist his army; this was not made a precedent for other cases.

s0175.literal: Three hundred persons in the capital guilty of bribery — the Emperor ordered that where the facts were not doubtful, judgment should follow the thirteen grades of punishment fixed by Kublai.
s0175.idiomatic: 300 persons in the capital guilty of bribery — the Emperor ordered that where the facts were not doubtful, judgment should follow the 13 grades of punishment fixed by Kublai.

s0176.literal: On jiyou day the moon encroached upon Kang.
s0176.idiomatic: On jiyou day the moon encroached upon Kang.

s0177.literal: On gengxu day in Guangxi salt was first issued on credit to the people and then the price was collected; private salt grew daily rampant; when the government sold salt itself, the people again would not buy.
s0177.idiomatic: On gengxu day in Guangxi salt was first issued on credit to the people and then the price was collected; private salt grew daily rampant; when the government sold salt itself, the people again would not buy.

s0178.literal: An edict directed that salt first be given to the people and then collected afterward.
s0178.idiomatic: An edict directed that salt first be given to the people and then collected afterward.

s0179.literal: On xinhai day central secretariat officials said: "State revenue has fixed annual quotas; the late Emperor once said: 'For all grants, though there be my decree, the Central Secretariat shall weigh them.'
s0179.idiomatic: On xinhai day central secretariat officials said, "State revenue has fixed annual quotas; the late Emperor once said, 'For all grants, though there be my decree, the Central Secretariat shall weigh them.'

s0180.literal: Hence annual spending was kept frugal and there were usually surpluses.
s0180.idiomatic: Hence annual spending was kept frugal and there were usually surpluses.

s0181.literal: Now princely and imperial-kin expenses are heavy and complex; remaining notes total only one hundred sixteen thousand two hundred-odd ingots.
s0181.idiomatic: Now princely and imperial-kin expenses are heavy and complex; remaining notes total only 116,200-odd ingots.

s0182.literal: Grain-purchase notes for Shangdu, Longxing, Xijing, Yingchang, Gansu, and other places are calculated to use more than two hundred thousand ingots; five-household silk manufacture and pigment notes for princes are calculated to use more than one hundred thousand ingots — and the princes coming to audience are still many; we fear there will be nothing to give.
s0182.idiomatic: Grain-purchase notes for Shangdu, Longxing, Xijing, Yingchang, Gansu, and other places are calculated to use more than 200,000 ingots; five-household silk manufacture and pigment notes for princes are calculated to use more than 100,000 ingots — and the princes coming to audience are still many; we fear there will be nothing to give.

s0183.literal: We request awaiting their return to their fiefs before we weigh and fix measures and report.
s0183.idiomatic: We request awaiting their return to their fiefs before we weigh and fix measures and report.

s0185.literal: On renzi day an edict, because military and civilian administrations were not unified, abolished the Huguang and Jiangxi mobile privy councils and merged them into branch secretariats.
s0185.idiomatic: On renzi day an edict, because military and civilian administrations were not unified, abolished the Huguang and Jiangxi mobile privy councils and merged them into branch secretariats.

s0186.literal: On yimao day Hexi monks were ordered to perform corvée labor as before.
s0186.idiomatic: On yimao day Hexi monks were ordered to perform corvée labor as before.

s0187.literal: On dingsi day Bayanchar was made deliberator of central secretariat affairs; his elder brother Bayan said: "I hold grand councillor rank; brothers should avoid mutual suspicion.
s0187.idiomatic: On dingsi day Bayanchar was made deliberator of central secretariat affairs; his elder brother Bayan said, "I hold grand councillor rank; brothers should avoid mutual suspicion.

s0188.literal: The Emperor said: "Do not speak of this again."
s0188.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "Do not speak of this again."

s0189.literal: An elder brother as grand councillor above and a younger brother as deliberator below — what is there to suspect?
s0189.idiomatic: An elder brother as grand councillor above and a younger brother as deliberator below — what is there to suspect?

s0190.literal: The Guichi garrison-farm general commission was abolished;
s0190.idiomatic: The Guichi garrison-farm general commission was abolished;

s0191.literal: The Xizang Sutra printing blocks of the Xuanzheng Commission were abolished.
s0191.idiomatic: The Xizang Sutra printing blocks of the Xuanzheng Commission were abolished.

s0192.literal: On gengshen day the moon encroached upon Bi.
s0192.idiomatic: On gengshen day the moon encroached upon Bi.

s0193.literal: On jiazi day an edict forbade those who commit offenses by deception.
s0193.idiomatic: On jiazi day an edict forbade those who commit offenses by deception.

s0194.literal: He Wei, pacification commissioner of Hunan Circuit, was made associate administrator of the Central Secretariat.
s0194.idiomatic: He Wei, pacification commissioner of Hunan Circuit, was made associate administrator of the central secretariat.

s0195.literal: The Haibei and Hainan maritime trade commissionerate was abolished.
s0195.idiomatic: The Haibei and Hainan maritime trade commissionerate was abolished.

s0196.literal: On renshen day a Verification Office was established.
s0196.idiomatic: On renshen day a Verification Office was established.

s0197.literal: A general commission for registering various household categories was established in Jining Route, at rank four.
s0197.idiomatic: A general commission for registering various household categories was established in Jining Route, at rank 4.

s0198.literal: On guiyou day Venus encroached upon Fang.
s0198.idiomatic: On guiyou day Venus encroached upon Fang.

s0199.literal: An edict changed the next year to Yuanzhen reign year one.
s0199.idiomatic: An edict changed the next year to Yuanzhen reign year 1.

s0200.literal: Twelfth month, on xinsi day Prince Yesima was granted fifty taels of gold.
s0200.idiomatic: Twelfth month, on xinsi day Prince Yesima was granted 50 taels of gold.
